verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents API access tokens (airbyte-docs-17) and mentions RBAC/SSO in its pricing tiers (airbyte-docs-29), implying some access-control capability, but there is no documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent's use. Missing for 10: explicit scoped/least-privilege token issuance workflow, agent-specific credential scoping, and any docs tying RBAC/token scopes to MCP/agent access.
